title: HSK 2.13 · 花园, 校园, 动物园, 停车场
focus: 急 · 疼 · 礼物 · 篇 · 千 · 墙 · 食物 · 吹 · 成绩 · 语言 · 雪 · 灯 · 太阳 · 爬 · 英语 · 喊 · 合适 · 答应 · 热情 · 骑 · 响 · 河 · 举 · 多久 · 感动 · 组成 · 不久 · 接下来 · 车辆 · 停车 · 花园 · 太太 · 校园 · 停车场 · 举手 · 下雪 · 英文 · 骑车 · 动物园
body:
Places (花园, 校园, 动物园, 停车场), weather (雪, 太阳) and feelings (急, 感动, 热情). 园 garden and 车 vehicle are the big repeaters.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 园 | yuán | garden, grounds (囗 enclosure + 元 yuán) | 花园, 校园, 动物园 |
| 车 | chē | vehicle | 车辆, 停车, 停车场, 骑车 |
| 物 | wù | thing | 礼物, 食物, 动物园 |
| 停 | tíng | to stop (亻 + 亭 tíng) | 停车, 停车场 |
| 久 | jiǔ | long (time) | 多久, 不久 |
| 语 | yǔ | language | 语言, 英语 |
| 英 | yīng | English (from 英国) | 英语, 英文 |
| 举 | jǔ | to lift | 举, 举手 |

## Watch out

- 千 qiān (thousand) vs 干 gàn: 千 starts with a slanting stroke.
- 答应 is dāying, not dá: compare 回答 huídá.
- 篇 piān (an article) vs 遍 biàn (a time through).

cards.Example: 别急，慢慢说。 bié jí, mànmàn shuō: Don't rush, take your time.
cards.Notes: Top ⺈ + 彐 over 心 heart: a hurried heart

cards.Example: 我头疼。 wǒ tóu téng: I have a headache.
cards.Notes: 疒 sickness + 冬 dōng (phonetic)

cards.Example: 这是给你的礼物。 zhè shì gěi nǐ de lǐwù: This is a present for you.
cards.Notes: 礼 courtesy (礻 altar) + 物 thing = a courtesy thing

cards.Example: 我写了一篇文章。 wǒ xiě le yì piān wénzhāng: I wrote an article.
cards.Notes: ⺮ bamboo (old writing slips) + 扁 biǎn (phonetic); lookalike 遍 biàn

cards.Example: 这个三千块。 zhège sānqiān kuài: This one is 3,000 yuan.
cards.Notes: 丿 + 十; lookalike 干 gàn (flat top stroke)

cards.Example: 墙上有一张画。 qiáng shang yǒu yì zhāng huà: There's a picture on the wall.
cards.Notes: 土 earth + 啬 sè; walls were built of earth

cards.Example: 这里的食物很好吃。 zhèlǐ de shíwù hěn hǎochī: The food here is great.
cards.Notes: 食 eat, food + 物 thing = things to eat

cards.Example: 吹一吹就不烫了。 chuī yi chuī jiù bú tàng le: Blow on it and it won't be hot.
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 欠 (a person with mouth open) = blowing

cards.Example: 他的成绩很好。 tā de chéngjì hěn hǎo: His grades are very good.
cards.Notes: 成 achieve + 绩 accomplishment (纟 + 责 zé) = what you achieved

cards.Example: 你会说几种语言？ nǐ huì shuō jǐ zhǒng yǔyán: How many languages do you speak?
cards.Notes: 语 speech + 言 words; 讠 is a squeezed 言

cards.Example: 外面在下雪。 wàimiàn zài xià xuě: It's snowing outside.
cards.Notes: 雨 rain on top + 彐 (a hand)

cards.Example: 请把灯关了。 qǐng bǎ dēng guān le: Please turn off the light.
cards.Notes: 火 fire + 丁 dīng (phonetic)

cards.Example: 太阳出来了。 tàiyáng chūlai le: The sun's come out.
cards.Notes: 太 great + 阳 sun (阝 hill + 日 sun) = the great sun

cards.Example: 孩子在地上爬。 háizi zài dìshang pá: The kid is crawling on the floor.
cards.Notes: 爪 claw + 巴 bā (phonetic)

cards.Example: 你的英语很好。 nǐ de Yīngyǔ hěn hǎo: Your English is very good.
cards.Notes: 英 (from 英国 England) + 语 language

cards.Example: 有人在喊你。 yǒu rén zài hǎn nǐ: Someone's calling you.
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 咸 xián (phonetic)

cards.Example: 这件衣服很合适。 zhè jiàn yīfu hěn héshì: This piece of clothing fits well.
cards.Notes: 合 fit together + 适 suit = fits right

cards.Example: 他答应我了。 tā dāying wǒ le: He said yes to me.
cards.Notes: 答 answer (here dā) + 应 respond = say yes

cards.Example: 他们对我很热情。 tāmen duì wǒ hěn rèqíng: They were very warm to me.
cards.Notes: 热 hot + 情 feeling = warm feelings

cards.Example: 我骑车上班。 wǒ qí chē shàngbān: I bike to work.
cards.Notes: 马 horse + 奇 qí (phonetic): ride a horse

cards.Meaning: to ring, make a sound; loud
cards.Example: 电话响了。 diànhuà xiǎng le: The phone's ringing.
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 向 xiàng (phonetic)

cards.Example: 河边有很多人。 hé biān yǒu hěn duō rén: There are lots of people by the river.
cards.Notes: 氵 water + 可 kě (phonetic)

cards.Example: 他举起了杯子。 tā jǔqǐ le bēizi: He raised his glass.
cards.Notes: Simplified from 舉, which has 手 hand at the bottom

cards.Example: 你等了多久？ nǐ děng le duōjiǔ: How long did you wait?
cards.Notes: 多 how much + 久 a long time

cards.Example: 我很感动。 wǒ hěn gǎndòng: I'm really touched.
cards.Notes: 感 feel + 动 move = feeling moved

cards.Example: 我们组成了一个队。 wǒmen zǔchéng le yí ge duì: We formed a team.
cards.Notes: 组 group (纟 + 且 qiě) + 成 become

cards.Example: 不久他就回来了。 bùjiǔ tā jiù huílai le: Before long he came back.
cards.Notes: 不 not + 久 long time

cards.Example: 接下来做什么？ jiēxiàlái zuò shénme: What's next?
cards.Notes: 接 take over + 下来 come down = what follows

cards.Example: 路上车辆很多。 lù shang chēliàng hěn duō: There's a lot of traffic.
cards.Notes: 车 vehicle + 辆 (measure for vehicles: 车 + 两 liǎng)

cards.Meaning: to park; to stop a vehicle
cards.Example: 这里不能停车。 zhèlǐ bù néng tíngchē: You can't park here.
cards.Notes: 停 stop (亻 + 亭 tíng) + 车 vehicle

cards.Example: 我家后面有个花园。 wǒ jiā hòumiàn yǒu ge huāyuán: There's a garden behind my house.
cards.Notes: 花 flower + 园 garden (囗 enclosure + 元 yuán)

cards.Example: 这是我太太。 zhè shì wǒ tàitai: This is my wife.
cards.Notes: 太 doubled; also Mrs. after a surname: 王太太

cards.Example: 我们的校园很大。 wǒmen de xiàoyuán hěn dà: Our campus is big.
cards.Notes: 校 school + 园 grounds

cards.Example: 停车场在哪儿？ tíngchēchǎng zài nǎr: Where's the parking lot?
cards.Notes: 停车 park + 场 open area

cards.Example: 有问题请举手。 yǒu wèntí qǐng jǔshǒu: If you have a question, raise your hand.
cards.Notes: 举 lift + 手 hand

cards.Example: 明天会下雪吗？ míngtiān huì xiàxuě ma: Will it snow tomorrow?
cards.Notes: 下 fall + 雪 snow

cards.Example: 这本书是英文的。 zhè běn shū shì Yīngwén de: This book is in English.
cards.Notes: 英 English + 文 writing

cards.Example: 我每天骑车上学。 wǒ měi tiān qíchē shàngxué: I bike to school every day.
cards.Notes: 骑 ride + 车 vehicle (here a bike)

cards.Example: 我们去动物园吧。 wǒmen qù dòngwùyuán ba: Let's go to the zoo.
cards.Notes: 动物 animal (moving thing) + 园 garden = animal garden
